actual_family.consecutive_actual_parameters: h maps to h+4, s maps to s-3, and p_h maps to p_h-2

terminal_normalization.three_adic_conclusion: x_h and u_h belong to 1+3Z_3 for every h>=1 with 3 not dividing h

primitive_carriers.primitive_reduction: N_x/E_x=A_x/D_x and N_u/E_u=A_u/D_u in lowest terms with positive denominators
primitive_carriers.mod_3: A_x=D_x nonzero mod 3 and A_u=D_u nonzero mod 3
primitive_carriers.actual_prime_bridge: X_h=0 mod p iff p divides N_x(h), and U_h=0 mod p iff p divides N_u(h)
primitive_carriers.scope: N_x and N_u are one-coordinate overcarriers; they do not retain Y_h or V_h and are not additive to the paired boundary carriers

holonomic_scope.proved: on each h mod 3 class, the unreduced cleared sequences are proper-hypergeometric finite sums and admit fixed-order polynomial recurrences
holonomic_scope.open: fixed-order polynomial recurrence for the primitive numerators after nonlinear gcd reduction
holonomic_scope.selector_mismatch: ordinary recurrence propagation works modulo a fixed prime, while the actual fixed-M modulus changes by 2 between consecutive actual h values

comparison_obstruction.sequence: C_h=(product_(4h<k<=18h, 3 does not divide k) k)^2
comparison_obstruction.unit: C_h is an integer congruent to 1 mod 3
comparison_obstruction.recurrence: E_h^2 C_(h+3)=R_h^2 C_h, with E_h a product of 8 and R_h a product of 36 integer-linear factors
comparison_obstruction.scope: the generic package of primitive integrality, 1 mod 3 normalization, fixed-order recurrence, and pointwise height cannot imply selector-weighted zero density

zero booking and zero capacity reduction
